jobs.title: Sr. Developer Advocate, AI and Machine Learning
Sr. Developer Advocate, AI and Machine Learning

reading.body:
Developer relations roles in AI remain sparse relative to the infrastructure work itself, as shown by only two open positions across major data platforms, both posted simultaneously and seeking identical expertise in different cities.

Databricks is actively recruiting senior advocates to bridge engineering and developer communities, which suggests the company is treating education and adoption as a scaling constraint. A single company posting the same role twice in different geographies indicates either high turnover, rapid team growth, or difficulty filling positions that require both technical depth and communication skills. Developer advocates are the connective tissue between platform capability and widespread use, making hiring in this function a signal that infrastructure companies believe their tools have matured beyond early adopters.

This data does not show how these roles map to total hiring, whether the positions fill quickly, or whether other infrastructure companies are similarly recruiting. The snapshot captures one moment across limited sources and may miss positions posted through private channels or filled before collection. It does reveal that someone training developers to use data platforms considers this work urgent enough to post twice in a single day.
